profile.subtitleJa: 群衆が押しかけたテサロニケの家の主人。
profile.summaryJa: テサロニケで、群衆がパウロ一行を探して家へ押しかけた際、その家の持ち主として名が出る。

facts.textJa: 告発者たちは、ヤソンがパウロたちを迎え入れたと主張した。
町の当局はヤソンたちから保証金を受け取って釈放した。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
